title: Had a dream last night about an announcement about a religious getaway being hosted at the Mall World
content: So I’m roaming this place that looks oddly similar to the [St. Charles Convention Center](https://stcharlesconventioncenter.com/), in St. Charles, MO, USA. During my exploration I see a flyer saying that a Christian college ministry group was planning to use the location for a religious retreat. I woke back up in the real world before I could make sense of what I was reading. Most of my Mall World dreams are just nonsense but this seems to be the first one with a “somewhat coherent storyline”-one that involves religion no less. Should I be bothered? Does this mean anything or…?
